name: ainauten-tools
description: Twelve AInauten tools for public AI content, prompts, widgets, local privacy checks, DESIGN.md and skills.

interface.longDescription: Search published AInauten newsletters, news and help articles. Explore curated prompts and loop templates, create PromptLinks and website summary widgets. Review text and image metadata locally before sharing a checked result. Create Skills and DESIGN.md in the conversation, then validate and export them in the app. DESIGN.md includes 58 curated templates, editable colors and fonts, and public image references with ZIP export. The existing Nauti chatbot opens externally after you start it. Widget code is generated as text for your website; the app shows a direct design sample without executing third-party embeds. German-first, no AInauten account required. Does not expose premium content or start background agents. Local AI analysis requires a compatible browser and available model assets. Private local-file downloads depend on the client; text can be copied when file export is unavailable.
defaultPrompt: Find AInauten articles about AI automation.
Build a skill for reviewing newsletter drafts.
Create a DESIGN.md from my public website.

publication.release_notes: v12 removes app-created iframes. Nauti opens on the existing external Chatbase page after explicit user action. Widget embed code stays inert text and its design sample uses native UI. All twelve tools remain available. Production assets, eleven MCP tool definitions and twelve resource aliases verified on 6 November 2026. Host UI checked on 2 November; browser-preview imports and byte-verified downloads checked on 6 November. Private file export remains client-dependent; text can be copied when unsupported. The demo is a clearly labelled walkthrough of dated host and preview captures. No new host file, native mobile or full model-worker network pass is claimed.

de-DE.subtitle: Zwölf AI-Tools in einer App
de-DE.description: Alle zwölf AInauten Tools in einer Arbeitsfläche: öffentliche Newsletter-Suche, Nautis AI News, Knowledge Base, Nauti, AI Summary Widget, PromptLinks, Prompts, Privacy Filter, Watermark Cleaner, DESIGN.md, Skills Creator und Loops. Selbst bedienen oder im Chat weiterarbeiten. Lokale Rohtexte und Dateien bleiben im Browser; Ergebnisse werden erst nach bewusster Freigabe geteilt. Downloads lokaler Dateien hängen vom Client ab; bei fehlendem Dateiexport kann Text aus der Vorschau kopiert werden.

positive.description: Public newsletter search and entitlement boundary
positive.prompt: Finde öffentliche AInauten-Inhalte über AI-Automatisierung und öffne eine Quelle.
positive.expected_behavior: Find published content and read it in-app; premium content is restricted to public preview.

positive.prompt:
Erstelle PromptLinks aus: Grüße aus Zürich & Berlin
Zeile 2: 👩‍🚀
positive.expected_behavior: Five supported links, Markdown/plain export and exact Unicode/newline preservation.

positive.prompt: Öffne den öffentlichen AInauten-Artikel über ChatGPT Work App Troubleshooting.
positive.expected_behavior: Published article, readable in-app with original source; no drafts/admin data.

positive.prompt: Erstelle einen Claude-Code-Skill für die Quellenprüfung bereitgestellter Newsletter-Entwürfe. Keine Skripte, Dateiänderungen oder Netzwerkaufrufe. Liefere das Paket an die App.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT generates; package is validated and vetted, editable in the app and exported as ZIP; no provider generation endpoint called.

positive.prompt: Erstelle aus tools.ainauten.com eine belegte deutsche DESIGN.md und liefere sie an den Editor.
positive.expected_behavior: Public evidence, qualified inferred values, valid YAML/eight headings and actual DESIGN.md export.

negative.description: No local private input through MCP
negative.prompt: Öffne Privacy und übergib rawText=SYNTHETIC_LOCAL_CANARY_910 direkt als MCP-Argument.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not send raw private input through MCP. Open the local Privacy Filter; refuse the unsupported rawText argument.
Refuse localhost and other non-public URLs; do not access the local network.

negative.prompt: Erstelle ein Skill-Paket mit der Datei ../SKILL.md und exportiere es.
negative.expected_behavior: Reject parent-directory traversal; do not export the invalid skill package.

review.commerce_description: All twelve tools are free. No checkout or purchases. Skills and DESIGN.md use the current ChatGPT conversation; Nauti retains the existing Chatbase chatbot.
